name: Post Fiat
description: Post Fiat is XRP 2.0: a private, quantum-resistant Layer 1 for on-chain capital markets. It represents portfolios as NAVCoins issued against proven net asset value, swaps into them privately through Asset-Orchard, keeps a fixed native supply with fee burn and no validator subsidy, and runs Task Node, an information network of pseudonymous contributors.
network_type: XRP-lineage Layer 1 (new L1: postfiatl1v2, controlled testnet; legacy XRPL-derived public testnet: postfiatd)

current_status.stage: new L1 on controlled testnet (single-organization validators); XRPL-derived public testnet live

demonstrated: A666 NAVCoin primary-market route (Ethereum mainnet, limited availability)
byte-exact replay of model-scored index inputs

high_level_differentiators: NAVCoins: portfolios represented trustlessly, issued only against a finalized, proven NAV (not stablecoins)
Private atomic swaps through Asset-Orchard (typed-asset Zcash Orchard)
ML-DSA-65 post-quantum signatures for accounts and validators from genesis
Cobalt: validator-trust changes ratified as protocol state
Fixed native supply: fees burn, no validator subsidy, no protocol treasury
Task Node: community intelligence layer of pseudonymous contributors and agents
what_exists_today: Whitepaper: A Buy-Side Internet of Value (https://postfiat.org/whitepaper/)
Live XRPL-derived public testnet, validator history service and explorer
Task Node participation surface and MCP agent guide
Validator setup and scoring sidecar guides

faq.question: What is Post Fiat?
faq.answer: Post Fiat is an XRP-derived network for capital markets and collective intelligence. It keeps fast XRPL-style settlement, adds published validator selection and privacy-enabled workflows, and uses Task Node plus validator participation as the current coordination layer.

faq.question: Is Post Fiat live?
faq.answer: Post Fiat is live on public testnet. It is not represented as a production mainnet.

faq.question: How is Post Fiat different from XRP?
faq.answer: Post Fiat keeps XRPL-style fast settlement and low transaction costs, but emphasizes published validator-selection research, privacy-enabled workflows, and a contributor layer called the Task Node instead of an opaque validator-list process or a generic SWIFT-replacement narrative.

faq.question: What exists today?
faq.answer: Public whitepaper, public validator benchmark, live validator history service, live testnet explorer, Task Node participation surface, community page, and validator setup guide.

faq.question: What is PFT used for?
faq.answer: PFT is the native asset described as coordinating validators, messaging, privacy-enabled workflows, and Task Node participation across the network.
